svg.title: Conditional full-capital recovery: end-value sensitivity
svg.desc: Conditional sensitivity figure. Combined 8.8 billion dollar budget, 9.6642 billion dollar tranche fees, credited 20 percent advance, five-year service equivalent, 10 percent hurdle. Three lines cross zero NPV at net first-term end-values of approximately 2.806, 3.423 and 4.039 billion dollars for the 85, 80 and 75 percent cash-share cases. These are model thresholds, not appraisals. Net end-value is before debt/equity allocation. The 85 percent project EBITDA estimate is not full free cash flow.
